title: "Exploring Storms"
author: "Your Name"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: storms-per-year

storms |>
  filter(status %in% c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) |>
  mutate(
    status = factor(
      status,
      levels = c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")
    )
  ) |>
  distinct(year, name, status) |>
  count(year, status) |>
  complete(year, status, fill = list(n = 0)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_area() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "tropical depression" = "lightblue",
      "tropical storm" = "orange",
      "hurricane" = "darkred"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Storms per Year by Type",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Storms",
    fill = "Storm Type"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: print-storms
#| cache: true

storms_recent <- storms |>
  filter(year >= 2000) |>
  select(year, name, status, wind, pressure)
```

```{r}
#| label: wind-pressure-plot

storms_recent |>
  ggplot(aes(x = wind, y = pressure, color = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Storm Pressure Decreases as Wind Speed Increases",
    subtitle = "Atlantic storm observations from 2000 to present, colored by storm status",
    x = "Wind Speed (knots)",
    y = "Air Pressure (millibars)",
    color = "Storm Status"
  )
```
